identifier.description: A name other blocks address this entry by.

expression.description: A column name or an expression over columns, e.g. "exp(LogL)".

agentOutput.description: Lossy agent digest export. Written only by `jplot <yaml>`; `jplot doctor` plans it. See `jplot man agent-output`.

enable.description: false disables this export even if the block is present.

method.description: Compression backend (bridson is an alias of voronoi partition).

max_cells.description: Upper bound on digest cells (budget, not a regular grid guarantee).

xbin.description: Alias: with ybin sets max_cells = xbin*ybin when max_cells omitted.

ybin.description: Alias: with xbin sets max_cells = xbin*ybin when max_cells omitted.

seed.description: RNG seed for reproducible site sampling.

geometry.description: none (default) omits polygon vertices to keep JSON small.

weight.description: auto | expression | {expr: ...}. auto uses type-macro weight when present.

include.description: Optional global summary blocks: quantiles, top_cells, tails, nan_stats, provenance, categorical.

strict.description: If true, digest failure fails the whole render (default false).

_digest_axes.description: Stashed by type expand for digest axes; not user-facing.
